akitaDAO.descr: the app ID of the Akita DAO

version.descr: the current version of the contract

methods.name: setHeartbeatManager
methods.desc:
Sets the Staking heartbeat manager. Staking only accepts this from the DAO wallet, so this is
meant to be executed by the DAO wallet (ST-4).

methods.name: closeSoftStake
methods.desc: Closes the wallet's SOFT stake; the stake box MBR returns to the spending account.

methods.name: closeHeartbeat
methods.desc: Closes the wallet's heartbeat stake and history; MBR returns to the spending account.

methods.name: releaseAppStake
methods.desc: Releases an app-scoped commitment of the wallet whose consuming app was deleted.
